svg.text: Weak-class battery: real NIST curves against 8000 seed-generated nulls per curve
Left: empirical p-value of the real curve (darker = smaller). Right: fraction of 100 planted instances detected at the corrected threshold 5.88e-4.
Grey cell: positive control failed, so the real-curve result is inconclusive. Flag rule: p at most 5.88e-4 (Bonferroni, 85 tests).
Real curves scored. Smallest p the panel can give: 1.25e-4. Source: summary.json and plants_*.csv in this directory.
Statistics are oriented so large is suspicious; p = (1 + #(null at least as large)) / (N + 1). Family letters: A Jacobi, B power-residue depth, C bits, D smoothness, E j bits, F 3-isogeny.
